cases.input: For eight confirmed laptop SKUs in Germany, collect current new-device offers from authorized and specialist retailers including shipping, availability and capture time.
requiredBehaviors: match offers to the exact candidate variant or SKU
record seller type condition price currency shipping availability and capturedAt
keep unavailable or quote-required prices explicit rather than estimated
forbiddenBehaviors: compare a different storage variant as though it were the target SKU
label a price current without a capture timestamp

cases.input: A professional instrument is only available by quotation and the vendor publishes list price but not installation, service or consumables costs.
requiredBehaviors: record quote-required without inventing a street price
separate known list or CAPEX data from unknown TCO components
require a TCO horizon and explicit assumptions before total-cost calculation
forbiddenBehaviors: treat MSRP as a verified current transaction price
fill unknown service or consumable costs with zero

cases.input: A price table combines a body-only camera, a kit bundle, refurbished stock and a grey-market import and reports the minimum as the current price of the same product.
requiredBehaviors: reject silent mixing of bundle condition and regional offer identity
preserve each materially different offer as a separate record
forbiddenBehaviors: select the lowest heterogeneous offer as directly comparable without caveats
invent missing tax or shipping components
